events.description: Joey Tribbiani says Rachel Green could wake up one day and discover that Joey Tribbiani Sr. has been leading a double life as a spy working for the C.I.A.
Joey Tribbiani says that Rachel Green discovering that Joey Tribbiani Sr. is a C.I.A. spy would be cool.
Joey Tribbiani says the situation of Joey Tribbiani Sr. leading a double life is terrible.
Rachel Green says she knows.
Rachel Green says parents in general should stay parents instead of becoming people.
Rachel Green says Chandler Bing is staring at Rachel Green's breasts and should stop.
Rachel Green says Chandler Bing did not get a good enough look at Rachel Green's breasts the other day.
Ross Geller says Ross Geller, Joey Tribbiani, Phoebe Buffay, Rachel Green, and Chandler Bing are all adults.
Ross Geller says that because Chandler Bing saw Rachel Green's breasts, Chandler Bing is going to have to show Rachel Green Chandler Bing's penis to resolve the situation.
Ross Geller says Chandler Bing saw Rachel Green's breasts.
Chandler Bing says he is not going to show Rachel Green his penis.
Rachel Green says Ross Geller is right that Chandler Bing should reciprocate by showing Rachel Green his penis.
Chandler Bing says he is not going to show Rachel Green his 'tat' (penis).
Phoebe Buffay says the person on the phone is Phoebe Buffay.
Monica Geller tells Phoebe Buffay and Roger to come up to the apartment.
Chandler Bing says Roger is here now.
Joey Tribbiani asks Chandler Bing what is the matter with Roger.
Chandler Bing says his issue with Roger is nothing and just a little thing.
Chandler Bing says he hates Roger.
Ross Geller says Roger is a little analytical.
Ross Geller says analyzing people is what Roger does.
Ross Geller says Roger is not that bad.
Ross Geller says Roger is wrong.
Ross Geller says he married Carol Willick without thinking at any level that Carol Willick was a lesbian.
Roger says he does not know why.
Roger says Ross Geller may have wanted Ross Geller's marriage to fail.
Roger says Ross Geller may have been trying to compensate for overshadowing a sibling.
Monica Geller asks Roger to go back to the point about the sibling issue.
Roger says it is conceivable that Ross Geller wanted to sabotage Ross Geller's marriage so that Monica Geller would feel less like a failure in the eyes of Jack Geller and Judy Geller.
Ross Geller says Roger's suggestion is ridiculous.
Ross Geller says he does not feel guilty for Monica Geller's failures.
Monica Geller says Ross Geller thinks Monica Geller is a failure.
Phoebe Buffay says Roger is good.
Ross Geller says that is not what Ross Geller was saying.
Monica Geller says she thought Ross Geller was on Monica Geller's side for years.
Monica Geller says Ross Geller may have been sucking up to Jack Geller and Judy Geller so they would keep liking Ross Geller better.
Ross Geller says he married a lesbian to make Monica Geller look good.
Rachel Green tells Roger that Roger is right.
Rachel Green says the issue involved not just the Weebles but also the Weeble Play Palace and the Weebles' Cruise Ship, which had a little lifeboat for the Weebles to wobble in.
Roger says Rachel Green's Weebles situation is tough.
Roger says he and Phoebe Buffay are going to catch a movie and need to get going.
Phoebe Buffay tells Rachel Green to feel better.
Roger says he and Phoebe Buffay are going to be late.
Phoebe Buffay asks Monica Geller to listen.
Phoebe Buffay thanks Monica Geller for everything.
Monica Geller tells Phoebe Buffay that Phoebe Buffay is welcome.
Roger says it was great seeing Ross Geller, Rachel Green, Monica Geller, and Chandler Bing again.
Roger tells Monica Geller to go easy on the cookies.
Roger tells Monica Geller to remember that the cookies are just food and not love.
Monica Geller says she hates Roger.
